decisions.reason: The construction site dumper builds directly on the firm's existing vehicle and construction equipment knowledge, enabling the firm to assimilate early feedback and improve the product, so a near-term drop is unlikely.

Although the inclined furniture lift is somewhat less central to the firm's core heavy machinery expertise, it still draws on the firm's lifting and transport know-how, allowing sufficient learning to justify keeping it.
The inclined building material lift aligns closely with the firm's construction and lifting capabilities, so the firm can interpret results and refine the product, making a drop improbable.

The truck-mounted inclined furniture lift combines the firm's vehicle and lifting expertise, fitting well with its existing knowledge base and enabling effective product improvement, so it is likely retained.
